# discord_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Discord channel webhook. Requires the bot to have `MANAGE_WEBHOOKS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_webhook" "deploys" {
  channel_id = "123456789012345678"
  name       = "Deploy Notifications"
}

output "deploy_webhook_url" {
  value     = discord_webhook.deploys.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the channel the webhook posts to. May be changed to move the webhook.
- `name` (String) Webhook name (1-80 characters). Must not contain the substring `clyde`.

### Optional

- `avatar` (String) Webhook avatar as a Discord image data URI (`data:image/png;base64,...`).

### Read-Only

- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild the webhook belongs to.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secure token of the webhook.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The full webhook URL (includes the token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Webhooks are imported using their webhook snowflake ID.
terraform import discord_webhook.deploys 987654321098765432
```
